name: Stop 1: Flat plateau
why: Smooth, flat ground in the HiRISE photo. A safe staging area to start the walk.

name: Stop 2: Layered terrace
why: A terrace between escarpments where layered rock is visible in the photo, a possible target for close-up observation.

name: Stop 3: Escarpment rim
why: The edge of a steep escarpment with exposed rock layers. Approach with caution; the slope map shows steep ground nearby.
